Shiny UI Module for Micro-Pilot Auto-Sizing and HPC Job Submission

Source: R/shiny_submit.R
mod_hpc_submit_ui.Rd

Provides a drop-in bslib card UI for configuring workload size, launching a non-blocking empirical micro-pilot, inspecting auto-sized SLURM resource recommendations (--array, --mem, --time, --cpus-per-task), and submitting array jobs to any SlurmBackend.

Usage

mod_hpc_submit_ui(
  id,
  title = "HPC Micro-Pilot & Submission",
  default_n_tasks = 20L,
  default_n_pilot = 3L,
  default_chunk_size = 4L,
  default_cpus = 1L,
  default_job_name = "slurmpilot_study",
  show_fault_toggle = FALSE
)

Arguments

id

Character module namespace ID.

title

Card header title. Default "HPC Micro-Pilot & Submission".

default_n_tasks

Default total number of tasks. Default 20L.

default_n_pilot

Default number of micro-pilot replications. Default 3L.

default_chunk_size

Default maximum tasks per chunk. Default 4L.

default_cpus

Default CPUs per array task. Default 1L.

default_job_name

Default SLURM job name. Default "slurmpilot_study".

show_fault_toggle

Logical; if TRUE, shows a checkbox to inject a recoverable single-chunk failure when using MockSlurmBackend (useful for interactive demos of surgical retry). Default FALSE.

Value

A bslib card UI element.

See also

mod_hpc_submit_server(), mod_hpc_monitor_ui()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("bslib", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ui <- mod_hpc_submit_ui("hpc_sub", default_n_tasks = 12L)
  inherits(ui, "shiny.tag")
}
#> [1] TRUE
